items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: Well, I'll tell you, like Dave Rose. Mm-hmm. Dave Rose and Elmer Schoeman and a few other guys

ctx.x: I know he arranged. Who were some of the good arrangers that you worked with? Worked with me?
Well, I'll tell you, like Dave Rose. Mm-hmm. Dave Rose and Elmer Schoeman and a few other guys, but I had a few of them that I can't remember the names.
